Basic Usage
===========

Here you describe the basic workflows: starting the dyno, loading a profile, monitoring signals, etc.

Example Flow
------------

1. Power up the MCLV-2 + DYNO hardware.
2. Connect the RS232/USB.
3. Start the GUI or X2C Scope.
4. Select the desired operating mode (DYNO or MOTOR).
5. Apply a simple constant load or speed setpoint.
